a261031p1.summary: Apple doesn't need fixing, and it doesn't want drama. Its new leader is a “product guy” who bleeds six colors.
a261031p1.title: John Ternus says Apple doesn't "want to ship AI for AI's sake" and that Tim Cook is "available to help wherever I ask" on policy; Ternus has yet to meet Trump (Steven Levy/Wired)

a261031p10.summary: Meta Platforms has built a prototype humanoid with Chinese robotics company Fourier and is already working on a second version …
a261031p10.title: Sources: Meta built a prototype humanoid robot with Chinese firm Fourier in three months and is building a second; Meta says it has no plans to sell these units (Jyoti Mann/The Information)

a261031p11.summary: A malicious ChatGPT share link could run an attacker's code in the logged-in session of anyone who opened it …
a261031p11.title: Researchers are paid $5K for reporting a bug to OpenAI that would let attackers run code in logged-in sessions of all who opened the hacker's ChatGPT share link (Swati Khandelwal/The Hacker News)

a261031p3.summary: Meta's outlook has been revised downward by S&P Global Ratings on concerns surrounding cash flow and AI spending.
a261031p3.title: S&P downgraded Meta's outlook from stable to negative, citing high capex and negative free cash flow; META fell 15% in October, its worst month in four years (Jonathan Vanian/CNBC)

a261031p4.summary: Lenders and investors are getting choosier about their bets and demanding stricter terms, as the AI build-out enters a new phase
a261031p4.title: Sources: neoclouds CoreWeave, Nebius, and Nscale have effectively been shut out of the bond market in recent weeks as lenders and investors demand tougher terms (Wall Street Journal)

a261031p5.summary: With data centers full of RAM, your PC is apparently the problem. … OpenAI CEO Sam Altman has data centers full of memory …
a261031p5.title: When talking about local inference, Sam Altman says supply-constrained DRAM is better used in data centers than sitting in PCs and "being used 5% of the time" (Andrew E. Freedman/Tom's Hardware)

a261031p6.summary: Scarce, controllable positions of Economic Power whose holders durably capture the gains of Increasingly Capable and diffused intelligence.
a261031p6.title: As AI models commoditize, lasting wealth will accrue to those controlling chokepoints like distribution, payment rails, and a stablecoin dollar, not to the labs (The Commanding Heights)

a261031p7.summary: Industry has drained the state's water reserves for decades. Data centers are the breaking point.﻿ — AA hulking gray giant rises from the desert.
a261031p7.title: A look at growing bipartisan opposition to AI data centers in drought-stricken Arizona, where TSMC's chip fabs were welcomed but newer projects face backlash (Gaby Del Valle/The Verge)

a261031p8.summary: As AI transforms writing and detectors like Pangram police what counts as machine-generated …
a261031p8.title: How AI detectors like Pangram are changing human writing: authors drop em dashes, "not X, but Y" phrasing, and words like "delve", or add typos, to look human (Morgan Meaker/Bloomberg)

a261031p9.summary: Cryptocurrency exchange Binance said on Saturday that it was able to cover 90% of the amount stolen during its recent hack.
a261031p9.title: Binance says it has covered 90% of its hack losses, having set aside $6.34B+ of company funds; the remaining 10% is in less liquid tokens (Angela Christy/Reuters)
